## Summary

## Parts

- [Partial] Longer Upper Radiator Hose: Approximately 13.25 inches or longer; standard options include an 11-inch and a 13.25-inch length. [t1483]

## Tips & gotchas

- Ensure the hose is long enough to prevent tension that could lead to cracks, but not so short it requires excessive trimming. [t1483]
